mintAuthority.summary: Canonical shares mint through the USDat ERC-4626 vault. A five-day self-administered timelock can replace mint logic, and a one-hour self-administered timelock controls parameters including oracle replacement. Complete native and timelock role-event replays are joined to current membership at block 26197300. Operator and parameter-proposer Fireblocks custody is disclosed, but signing independence and approval policies remain unresolved. Independent financial and legal recovery reconciliation remains unavailable; representation powers stay in Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197300, hash 0xcc2d6fe52717666f3a8700dbef29e3c77c5657a006aaac60c928cba68a12ab03, timestamp 2026-10-15T10:25:11Z, implementation, underlying asset, share supply, totalAssets and timelock delays were refreshed. Complete native proxy RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay from creation block 24629457 through the pin returned 17 events, joined to current hasRole for all nine active-implementation memberships. DEFAULT_ADMIN is the upgrade timelock; OPERATOR, SURPLUS_MANAGER and MARKET_MODE_MANAGER are 0xc35580434261f667d6abbda9e3dc1dc31e5a1b92; PARAMETER_MANAGER, ENFORCER and UNPAUSER are the parameter timelock; BLACKLISTER and PAUSER are 0xf5a93281ac8604f99755cc489317e75ac334cfe2. Legacy PROCESSOR_ROLE remains at 0x09d6e34ce24d54890ff0bc6a090b5f880f8c729f and COMPLIANCE_ROLE at 0x10d59f776db12b4b271b2609cb8b7ddd0a82703b; V2 has no entrypoints gated by those retired identifiers, so historical memberships do not establish current economic powers. Complete genesis-to-pin timelock replay returned eight role events and current hasRole agreed with every resulting membership: self-only DEFAULT_ADMIN, sole proposer/canceller 0x610182581c93687ca03f4a8e7f124f8cec616820 for the five-day upgrade timelock and 0x7a5a4064005584bc727666ec82548a9139d5f21e for the one-hour parameter timelock, with open executors. The exact issuer configuration identifies V2 operator Fireblocks MPC custody and a configured Fireblocks parameter proposer; approval quorum and independent human control remain unresolved. Earlier prose denying exact custody binding is superseded. No fixed non-raiseable issuance bound is established. The official Certora Saturn-sUSDat V2 PDF retrieved on 2026-10-15 is headed Security Assessment Final Report, not DRAFT. Review dates are 27 July to 5 August 2026, initial commit 4157ff8 and final f9bb4f9; it lists 11 confirmed low findings (9 fixed, 2 acknowledged), one informational finding (fixed), and no critical/high/medium findings. Acknowledged L-01 covers fail-closed oracle/totalAssets availability and L-08 just-in-time redemption-fee capture. Earlier Three Sigma and Certora reports retain their older scopes. No security report establishes independent reserve-to-liability assurance, exact deployed-build equivalence, holder priority or executed recovery rights. Mint review is scoreable; financial and signing-policy gaps remain separate.
